title: business
body:
# Businesses plugin is a plugin for minecraft **1.20-1.21**

This plugin introduces businesses to minecraft, if you hace essentials plugin in your server when you create a enterprise you will pay a tax of 3000 for creation

## Commands
/createBusiness <Name> [Type] Creates your business
/addEmployee <BusinessName> <PlayerName> add a player to your business
/removeEmployee <BusinessName> <Employee> Remove a employee from your business
/listEmployees <BusinessName> List the employees on your business
/listBusiness List the business created on the server
/payEmployees <BusinessName> <Salary> Pays all employees on your business
/removeBusiness <BusinessName>
/businessInfo <BusinessName> Print the information of your business

## Permissions
enterprises.use
enterprises.create
enterprises.addEmployee
enterprises.listEmployees
enterprises.listBusinesses
enterprises.paySalaries
